question: Can current WZZT recover shallow but nonzero root branches that default RNJ omits under its global grouping tolerance?

scope.geometry_truth_use: explicit oracle mechanism diagnostic, not an observed-data result

physical_change.fields: multiply length_m, r_ohm and x_ohm by the declared root-only multiplier after reference impedance scale=1 conversion
unchanged: all other line lengths and impedance per km
terminal and root meter error law

geometry_stage.generation: physical line sums give exact squared-voltage R/X; production sensitivity_geometry and rooted_neighbor_joining only
report: compatibility of each missing root clade with retained peripheral clades

future_observed_stage.pairing: same base load, physical-root and meter innovations across R0/R1/R2; AC regenerated for each physical network

future_algorithms.rnj: unchanged ordered R/X QP, RX75 and tolerance0.16
future_algorithms.wzzt: unchanged current joint-refit greedy path initialized by data-selected bootstrap peripheral clades; 100 bootstrap, length4, threshold0.75, max2
future_algorithms.full_rnj_lp: fit weights on the algorithm-generated full RNJ family plus singletons
future_algorithms.pooled_final_selection: same independent validation blocks and common one-SE rule for RNJ candidate and all WZZT path points
future_algorithms.bound_expansion: unchanged default; never introduce a positive parameter lower bound

primary: WZZT-only selected result separately from pooled selected result
where a missing root clade entered the actual path
secondary: algorithm-selected initial-block compatibility (post hoc truth audit only)
evaluation.wzzt_correction_success: RNJ has a root-level error, actual WZZT-selected path corrects it while retaining all peripheral true clades and introducing no false clade; pooled selection must select that WZZT-derived model to claim deployed correction
not_success: pooled model only falls back to RNJ
oracle correct-support fit succeeds but WZZT fails
best truth-picked path point succeeds but validation-selected point fails

stop_rules: Report all three declared ratios; do not choose successful ratios or seeds after observing results
If RNJ errors are not root-localized, report that condition as failing the intended mechanism rather than deleting it
If selected initial clades cross true root clades, record the structural incompatibility; do not silently remove them
If WZZT cannot correct in-domain missing roots, retain failure and diagnose its search; do not add favorable load variation or lower noise
Keep original N0/N1 baseline results as the normal references; this is a separate physical-parameter sensitivity case
No new price comparison or larger MILP batch until the normal baseline diagnosis is complete

alternative_not_selected.root_meter_outliers: would mix RNJ front-end squared-loss and WZZT absolute-loss robustness; must include matched-variance Gaussian control if ever studied, and cannot be presented as the main structural advantage case
alternative_not_selected.weak_root_suite: changes physical root-voltage sigma only; observed-root squared-voltage subtraction removes its direct common contribution, so it does not directly create a weak root branch
alternative_not_selected.low_samples_or_correlated_loads: can reduce information for both methods and disturb peripheral blocks; not selected for this first root-localized mechanism test

limits: Known synthetic physical lengths define the test case only, not candidate selection
No claim that these lengths are empirically calibrated
RNJ tolerance loss does not imply information-theoretic non-identifiability
WZZT admissibility only creates an opportunity; actual greedy recovery and independent validation remain unverified
